title: LRU Cache
prompt: Design a data structure that follows the constraints of a Least Recently Used cache with O(1) get and put operations.
hints: You need both fast lookup and fast eviction updates.
A doubly linked list plus a hash map is a classic approach.

title: Word Ladder
prompt: Given a begin word, end word, and a word list, return the length of the shortest transformation sequence.
hints: This is a shortest-path problem on an implicit graph.
Breadth-first search is usually the right starting point.
